course.title: Surveying
course.department: Department of Building Engineering and Construction Management

content.value: To find the elevation of top of a tower of KUET, observations were made from two stations P and R, 30 m apart. The horizontál angle measured at P between R and top of the tower was 60º15' and that measured at R between top of the tower and P station was 6820'. The angle of elevation was measured 10º45'.at R and. 10º20' at P. Staff readings on BM when the instrument was at P = 1.969 m and at R = 2.073 m. Calculate the elevation of top of the tower of KUET if BM was 200 m.

topics: Reconnaissance survey; Linear measurements; Traverse survey; Plane table survey; Levelling & contouring; Calculation of areas and volumes; Tachometry: Introduction, principles and problems on tachometry; Astronomical surveying: Definition, instruments, astronomical corrections, systems of time; Introduction of terrestrial photography, aerial photography, reading of photo mosaic, scale Project surveying; Errors in surveying; remote sensing; Introduction and application of global positioning system (GPS) and geographical information system (GIS), House setting.
_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 1st Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2018
classification_notes: প্রশ্নটিতে উচ্চতা নির্ণয়, ভূমিরেখা (contouring), এবং ত্রিকোণমিতীয় পরিমাপের মূলনীতি ব্যবহার করা হয়েছে যা সিলেবাসের প্রথম টপিকে অন্তর্ভুক্ত Levelling ও Tachometry-এর সাথে সরাসরি সম্পর্কিত।
verification_notes: প্রশ্নটিতে উচ্চতা নির্ণয়ের জন্য ত্রিকোণমিতীয় পদ্ধতি ও staff reading ব্যবহার করা হয়েছে যা Levelling এবং Tachometry-এর সিলেবাসের সাথে সরাসরি মিলে।
